This fixed-dose inhaler combines three therapies into a single device for better treatment outcomes. It aims to benefit over 55 million people living with COPD across the country. The Drug Controller General of India has approved this innovative product for use. Lupin is currently ranked second in the respiratory therapy segment in India.

Jindal Stainless, Indian Oil renew lubricants partnership for five years, eye deeper technical cooperation
items.summary: Jindal Stainless and Indian Oil have renewed their lubricant supply partnership for another five years, extending their vendor-managed inventory arrangement at the Hisar unit. The companies said the renewed agreement will support equipment reliability, operational efficiency and energy supplies while opening scope for deeper technical cooperation.
